text: hey i want you to go in on some shaders for the game materials in hmsc-int, lets get variety variety variety. more sidewalk textures, wood, brick, stone, metal, wall papers, gradients, i want quanity quantity quantity. we can always remove the bad ones but we will always wonder where are the good ones if we dont make a catalog of them
resolution: Expanded hmsc-int procedural material shader catalog with five new fill boards K-O: street ground, wood/brick/stone, metal, wallpapers, and gradients. Added 35 material recipes with three takes each, WGSL render implementations and dispatch, category mapping, seed range expansion, and a focused catalog contract test. Verified with the shader catalog test and hmsc-int bundle-only check.
